    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])

    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    shapes=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c] and g[r][c]!=2 and not seen[r][c]:
                col=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; cells=[]
                while stack:
